title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server (SAP Message Server) does not properly size memory allocations when… (CVE-2026-120010)
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in SAP NetWeaver Application Server (SAP Message Server) due to improper sizing of memory allocations when processing certain HTTP requests. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to cause the component to abort, leading to denial of service until the system is restarted. This vulnerability impacts system availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity.
